thread:
sahil: Heads-up — scheduling users_profile_pk_swap migration tonight in the 23:00-23:30 PT change window. Need lease handoff across 4 shards, and we'll pin API to a safe build during the op.
sahil: Goal is zero downtime but expect brief lock spikes; plan is staggered per-shard, 10m slack between shards.
deploy-bot: Scheduled by @sahil for 2026-06-12 23:00 PT. Reminder will fire 15m before window.
dbadmin_tom: I can run the lease-swap and monitor row-level locks. Will produce a pre-check diff and a quick rollback script.
dbadmin_tom: Preflight checklist:
```
1) run ./scripts/schema/check_constraints.sh users_profile
2) ensure replica lag < 500ms
3) capture active tx count: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';
```
maya: I'll pin the api service to v3.2.1 on the canary pool and then scale canary->100% during shard 2 if everything looks green. Command I'll use: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v3.2.1 --namespace=prod`
carla: Add me on pager for shard 3 and 4. I'll watch error budgets and SLO dashboards.
ops_jen: Rollback decision criteria we agreed: if 5m error rate > 2% OR p99 latency increase > 1000ms on write path, abort and revert image + run escape hatch to reassign old PK mapping.
ops_jen: Rollback quick commands: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod` and the DB escape hatch is `UPDATE migration_locks SET holder = previous_holder WHERE id = 'users_profile';` (run only after approval).
dbadmin_tom: I'll stage the lock-handoff script per shard: `./ops/lease_handoff.sh --shard=1 --apply` — will do dry-run first.
sahil: Can we add a temporary feature-flag to disable profile writes for 60s if things go sideways? That gives us a softer failure mode.
maya: Yes, feature flag `profile_write_block` ready in LaunchDarkly, set to OFF then toggle to ON if we need to quiesce writes.
dbadmin_tom: Preflight run (shard 1) output: no blocked transactions, replica lag 120ms, constraints OK. Dry-run lease_handoff succeeded.
sahil: Ok proceed shard 1 at T+0. @deploy-bot please hold autoscale and any schema deploys during window.
deploy-bot: Autoscale and schema deploy blockers set for 23:00-23:40 PT.
carla: Watching metrics — shard 1 lease handoff started. small p99 spike observed (200ms) but within threshold.
dbadmin_tom: Completed shard 1. Cleared locks. Moving to shard 2 after 10m stabilization.
carla: Shard 2 started. Noting a 1.2s hiccup on a single host; ops_jen investigating.
ops_jen: Cause: transient CPU steal on host-h12, draining and restarting pod fixed it. No rollback yet.
maya: Canary still healthy; errors at 0.3%. Pin maintained.
dbadmin_tom: Shard 2 completed. Proceeding shard 3.
carla: Shard 3 saw a brief 3% error burst for 30s, reverted feature flag `profile_write_block` to ON to quiesce writes. Errors came from a throttled downstream indexer.
sahil: Good call on the flag. We'll pause and let downstream catch up — hold shard 4 until indexer backlog < 1k.
dbadmin_tom: Backlog now 420, moving to shard 4 in 12m.
carla: Monitoring, no elevated errors.
ops_jen: Conditions good. If anything crosses thresholds, we'll execute rollback plan; otherwise finalize.
dbadmin_tom: Completed shard 4 and final PK swap. Ran quick integrity queries: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE profile_id IS NULL;` -> 0.
maya: Unpinning api image now, rolling to latest stable. `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:stable --namespace=prod`
deploy-bot: Deployment completed. Release notes: 1) users_profile_pk_swap applied across 4 shards; 2) lease handoff used; 3) no data loss reported.
sahil: Thanks everyone — closing the change window. Postmortem: short note in #postmortems tomorrow AM, include metrics and exact timeouts.
carla: Logging lessons: add extra monitoring for indexer queue to avoid the shard 3 pause.
ops_jen: Agreed. Also add an automated feature-flag playbook to the runbook.
deploy-bot: Reminder set to create release-summary thread in #releases in 1h.
